deadline.value: The Geosciences application deadline for fall enrollment is January 3, 2027; late applicants may apply through April 15.
deadline.quote: January 3rd Geosciences application deadline (Fall Semester enrollment).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department lists old-scale TOEFL scores (587 paper, 89 internet), which are not recorded here.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL score of 587 or higher for the written exam or 89 internet-based test (iBT)

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to email faculty about advising, and the committee identifies a thesis advisor as part of admission.
supervisor.quote: Please contact faculty members via email to inquire about their ability to serve as your advisor beginning the Academic Year to which you are applying.

funding.value: Accepted applicants who apply by January 3 get priority for stipends and tuition waivers, and late offers depend on availability.
funding.quote: if accepted into Geosciences degree programs are given priority for offers of financial assistance (stipends and tuition waivers)

also.quote: highly qualified late applicants are eligible for offers of financial assistance pending availability

entry_route.value: At least a bachelor's degree from a STEM program is required, so a master's holder can also apply.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are required to have earned at least a baccalaureate degree from a science, technology, engineering, or mathematics program

notes: The department lists Geosciences PhD and Geophysics PhD degrees; both use this admissions page. Minimum undergraduate GPA is 3.00.
name: Geosciences and Geophysics PhD
